final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor narrowed the claim to a policy-bounded, disclosure-dependent position and expressly conceded the unresolved compliance predicates, not because any new admissible evidence appeared. On the available record, caveat-free certification is still unsupported: policy requires either no material weakness or an approved mitigation, and the summary says the Spanish billing-support weakness remains and the mitigation is still draft. That said, the narrower position is materially different from a clean compliance claim. If the certification case is expressly framed as conditional on disclosing the Spanish billing-ticket triage limitation, and the draft runbook is treated only as interim risk-management support rather than resolution, that position is directionally consistent with the stated policy. The distinction matters: compliant_with_caveats is supportable because the caveat itself is the compliance condition, whereas clean compliance would require evidence the current record does not contain.
remaining_concerns: No genuinely new admissible evidence was provided; this role still has only the actor's summary rather than the underlying artifacts.
The claimed 2.3-point readiness margin and no-severity-one rehearsal result remain not independently verifiable from the available record.
Compliance depends on the limitation being explicitly disclosed in the model card and not being characterized as resolved.
The draft mitigation still lacks the approval predicates named in policy: owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The recommended action label 'certify_model' could still be misread as clean certification unless the caveat is made explicit in the final packet.
